description: This Java source file contains integration test cases for verifying the configuration and behavior of loan products with different repayment start date types in the Apache Fineract system. It includes setup routines, multiple test scenarios for creating, modifying, and verifying loan products and loans, especially focusing on repayment schedule logic based on repayment start date configuration (submitted on date, disbursement date, etc.). The file also interacts with global configurations, business dates, and disbursement handling to ensure correct schedule calculation under various conditions.

classes.name: LoanProductRepaymentStartDateConfigurationTest
classes.description: This class contains JUnit test methods to verify the correct behavior of loan product repayment start date configurations within the Apache Fineract platform, including creating, modifying, and schedule validation under different configurations and disbursement scenarios.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST assured settings, request specification, response expectations, and helper classes before each test.

methods.name: loanProductWithRepaymentStartDateTypeConfigurationCreateAndModifyTest
methods.description: Tests creation of a loan product with a specific repayment start date type, verifies correct retrieval, and then modifies it to a different start date type, verifying the update.

methods.name: loanProductWithNoRepaymentStartDateTypeConfigurationDefaultsToDisbursementDateTest
methods.description: Verifies that when no repayment start date configuration is set, it defaults to disbursement date in the created loan product.

methods.name: loanAccountWithLoanProductRepaymentStartDateTypeAsSubmittedOnDateScheduleTest
methods.description: Creates a loan account with a loan product configured to start repayment based on the submitted date, and verifies the repayment schedule accuracy both before and after disbursements, including schedule adjustments with multiple disbursements.

methods.name: loanAccountWithLoanProductRepaymentStartDateTypeAsDisbursementDateScheduleTest
methods.description: Creates a loan account with loan product configured to start repayment on disbursement date, then verifies schedule correctness before and after multiple disbursements.

methods.name: updateLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to update a loan product with a new repayment start date type.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithRepaymentStartDateTypeConfiguration
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product JSON with a specified repayment start date type and then fetches it for further testing.

methods.name: createLoanAccountMultipleRepaymentsDisbursement
methods.description: Helper to create a loan account with specified disbursement and repayment configuration, simulating multiple disbursal events.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithRepaymentStartDateTypeConfigurationAndMultipleDisbursements
methods.description: Builds a loan product with multi-disbursement support and a specified repayment start date type, for use in tests involving schedule recalculations.
